name: NVIDIA RTX 5080 llama.cpp: gpt-oss 20B (MXFP4) token generation at 4k context
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Hardware Corner GPU LLM Benchmarks page, tables dated March 2026). llama.cpp llama-bench, GGUF, single GPU, batch-1. NVIDIA RTX 5080. gpt-oss 20B (MXFP4). Number is the 4k-context column of the Token Generation table: context depth the run was measured at, not a fixed pp512/tg128. Per-request, NOT aggregate.
